verdict.one_line_verdict: The most governance-mature entry: server-side AUTO/ASK/BLOCK, published trust labels with provenance, a verifiable audit chain and no way for an agent to approve. Points off for a 500 on mismatched requirements, untracked stock labelled DECLARED and an unauthenticated human channel.
